objectives:
(Course taught in English)
The purpose of this course is to equip/enhance students with the capability of conducting academic research in marketing channels, as well as paper publication capability if possible. In order to achieve the goal, for the first half of the course, we will have several classes associated with the background knowledge of channels of distribution. For the second half of the course, participating students need to present up-to-date channel articles so as to get familiar with what research articles are and what have been done in the existing channel literature. At the end, according to the reading, participating students are requested to propose a doable marketing channel proposal. Later on, if they are still interested, we will help the students to complete the proposals.
content:
(Course is taught in English)
The first half of the course is teaching-oriented, based on the handout made by Dr. Cheng, while the second half is based on paper presentations.
